entries.title: Crosshair Placement
entries.content: Keep your crosshair at head level at all times. Pre-aim common angles where enemies peek. This reduces the distance you need to flick and dramatically improves first-bullet accuracy.

entries.title: Movement Accuracy
entries.content: Stop moving completely before shooting. Counter-strafe by tapping the opposite movement key to stop instantly. Your bullets are wildly inaccurate while moving in Valorant.

entries.title: Economy Management
entries.content: Full buy when your team has 3900+ credits. Force buy together as a team, never split buy. Save (eco) rounds: buy only a Sheriff or Spectre. Losing bonus gives 1900 after 2 losses.

entries.title: Default Setups
entries.content: On attack, spread across the map in a default setup to gain map control and information. Send 1-2 players to each area. Only commit to a site execute after gathering intel.

entries.title: Peeking Techniques
entries.content: Use jiggle peeks to bait out shots and gather info without dying. Wide swing when you know where the enemy is. Never crouch-peek — it makes your head an easy target.

entries.title: Spray Control
entries.content: The Vandal and Phantom spray patterns pull up then left-right. For the first 5 bullets, pull down slightly. At range, burst fire 2-3 bullets at a time instead of spraying.

entries.title: Post-Plant Positioning
entries.content: After planting the spike, play off the bomb from cover. Don't peek unnecessarily — the defenders must come to you. Listen for defuse audio cues. The spike takes 7 seconds to defuse.

entries.title: Retake Priorities
entries.content: On retake, clear angles methodically rather than rushing. Use utility to clear common plant spots. Trade kills with your teammates. Always know how many enemies are alive.

entries.title: Smoke Timing
entries.content: On defense, wait to smoke until you hear the enemy pushing. On attack, smoke chokepoints just before executing onto a site. Smokes last about 15 seconds for most controllers.

entries.title: Flash Usage
entries.content: Pop flash for your teammates — call out before flashing so they can peek with it. Don't flash through smokes. Right-click Skye flash for close range, left-click for distance.

entries.title: Audio Cues
entries.content: Footsteps are audible within 40 meters. Walk (hold shift) when near enemies. Abilities like Omen teleport and Jett dash make distinct sounds. The spike beep speeds up at 25 seconds.

entries.title: Map Control
entries.content: Control mid on most maps — it gives you access to both sites and forces defenders to watch more angles. Clear and hold mid with utility before committing to a site.

entries.title: Off-Angle Play
entries.content: Hold unexpected angles that enemies won't pre-aim. Stand further back from corners to see the enemy first. Off-angles give you a reaction time advantage but are single-use.

entries.title: Attacking Tempo
entries.content: Vary your attack timing — don't always rush or always play slow. Fast executes work against heavy utility defense. Slow plays work against aggressive defenders who peek early.

entries.title: Sentinel Setup
entries.content: Place Killjoy turrets and alarmbot to cover flanks, not to get kills. Cypher tripwires should be placed at ankle height on common paths. Move setups between rounds to stay unpredictable.

entries.title: Vandal vs Phantom
entries.content: Vandal: one-tap headshot at any range, louder, harder spray. Phantom: faster fire rate, silenced, better spray control but 140 damage headshot at range. Use Phantom for close maps.

entries.title: Trading Kills
entries.content: Always trade your teammates' deaths within 2 seconds. Stay close enough to refrag but not so close you both die to the same spray. This is the most important team mechanic.

entries.title: Anti-Eco Rounds
entries.content: On anti-eco (opponents saving), don't push aggressively — play safe with your better weapons. Sheriffs can one-tap, so respect even eco rounds. Maintain distance advantage.

entries.title: Duelist Entry
entries.content: Duelists should entry first using their abilities. Jett dash or Raze satchel in. Use flashes or smokes before entering. Your team should be right behind you to trade.

entries.title: Ability Economy
entries.content: Don't waste abilities early in the round. Save signature abilities for key moments. Buy utility that matches your team's plan. Orbs on the map recharge signature abilities.
